chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, said: We were told by Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, who ascribed it (to an Imam), regarding the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: "And from the evil of the jealous when he emits jealousy." He said: Have you not seen him when he opens his eyes while he looks at you? It is that.
And from the evil of the jealous when he emits jealousy.
He said: Have you not seen him when he opens his eyes while he looks at you? It is that.
ai.seo_question: What is the physical sign of jealousy according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Mani al-Akhbar*, Shaykh al-Saduq transmits this narration to elucidate the specific mechanism of *hasad* (jealousy) mentioned in Surah Al-Falaq, linking the internal malice to its external physical manifestation. The hadith highlights that the 'evil' is not merely abstract but is actively emitted through the gaze, a concept deeply rooted in Shia tradition regarding the power of the eye (*ayn*) to cause harm. This interpretation underscores the practical need for believers to seek divine protection not just from the jealous person's intent, but from the tangible spiritual impact of their look.
